combo.title: Menus
combo.noResultsMessage: Change the search or the filters.

live.appInactive: This app is not active in this business

menus.empty: No menus yet. Create the first one with the + button.
menus.loadError: The menus could not be loaded.

delete.title: Withdraw this menu?
delete.message: «{name}» stops being on sale, together with its courses and choices. Tickets already issued keep reading it.

form.name: Name
form.kitchenNameHelp: Leave it empty and the kitchen ticket uses the commercial name.
form.priceHelp: What the customer pays for the whole menu, whatever they pick.
form.supplyServiceHelp: ONE line at the menu's own rate, drinks included. This is the Spanish menu del día.
form.supplyGoods: Sold as a product / to take away
form.supplyGoodsHelp: The closed price is SPLIT into ONE LINE PER COMPONENT, each at its own rate.
form.taxCategoryHelp: The rate the whole menu is billed at.
form.noTaxCategory: A menu eaten in needs its own VAT category: without it, it cannot be billed.

money.notAmount: This is not an amount. Type a figure, for example 12.50.
money.negative: A menu price cannot be below zero. To make a choice cheaper, give it a negative supplement instead.
money.ambiguous: This amount can be read in two ways: «{typed}» could be {grouped} or {decimal}. Write the decimals so there is no doubt.

builder.serviceWarning: This menu is billed as a single service: one line at its VAT category, whatever the components are taxed at.
builder.goodsWarning: This menu is billed as goods: its price will be split across the components you add, one line each.
builder.goneMessage: It has been withdrawn, perhaps from another device.

courses.title: Courses
courses.help: A course is a step of THIS menu — Starter, Main, Dessert, Drink. Its order is the order it is asked for.
courses.empty: No courses yet. Add the first one — a menu with no course has nothing to pick.
courses.loadError: The courses of this menu could not be loaded.
courses.deleteMessage: Remove the course «{name}» and its choices?

courseForm.name: Course name
courseForm.minHelp: 1 or more makes the course compulsory. 0 makes it optional. There is no separate switch.
courseForm.repeat: The same option may be picked more than once
courseForm.ceiling: The maximum ({max}) is below the minimum ({min}): nobody could ever satisfy this course.

choices.title: Choices
choices.empty: No choices yet: nobody can resolve this course.
choices.deltaHelp: What substituting adds to the CLOSED price. It may be negative.
choices.editing: Editing «{article}». It keeps its position in the course.
choices.duplicate: This course already offers that product. To let it be picked twice, switch on «the same option may be picked more than once».

status.not_by_unit: Not sold by units in Inventory
status.untaxed: No VAT category to take away

bulk.none: Tick at least one product first.
bulk.empty: No products in the catalogue yet.
